summary: 'You're welcome' is the WELCOME sign, an open hand sweeping in toward your body, often with a small nod. Some signers use a flat hand that opens out from the chin instead.
steps: Hold an open hand out to the side, palm up.
Sweep it in toward your waist in one smooth motion.
mistakes: Overthinking it. A quick WELCOME with a nod is all most people use.

faq.q: Is there a difference between WELCOME and YOU'RE WELCOME?
faq.a: Not really. The same sign serves both. Context and the nod make it a reply.
